exact_cache.cost_estimate_meaning: Public cold shape proxy or own prior successful full-call mean; fallible, with failures censored rather than treated as cheap completion.
exact_cache.forecast_service: Immutable forecast emitted before the current provider computation; current paid cache may supply an exact point.
exact_cache.purchase_count_meaning: Physical provider attempts, including failures; exact cache uses are separate.
exact_cache.setup_scope: Local controller initialization included. Installed shared source registry is billed separately and equally by the experiment runner.
exact_cache.theorem_disposition: Greedy marginal actions and optional/cached acquisition have no inherited randomized-action/one-cold-purchase guarantee.
